thread:
elaine (partnerships): Quick heads-up — IntegratorX just dropped a lead for OmniRetail via their SI intake form. They want to be the primary co-sell owner for this account. cc @sam @deepak — any objections to letting them own the first outreach window?
sam (sales): Thanks. What's the lead source and whether it's net-new vs existing?
elaine (partnerships): Source=SI intake (IntegratorX). Account appears net-new to us, no recent touches in SFDC.
deepak (solutions_eng): Can we confirm they did a joint demo or POC? If SI invested PS time, we should respect claim; otherwise we keep AE lead but give SI nurture rights.
tina (field_engage): Practically, I propose: SI gets a 21-day exclusive claim if they generated the opportunity and logged a demo/POC. After 21 days, if no pipeline progress, AE auto-claims. We should map this into CRM tags + a quick nudge cadence.
elaine (partnerships): I like the 21-day rule. For marketplace leads we do 14 days, but for HW/SI integrated partners give 21. Also want to ensure IntegratorX signs an NDA for joint announcements before we let them be primary.
sam (sales): Agree. Also need a deal desk check for split rules. If IntegratorX closes, revenue share and attribution need pre-clear.
deepak (solutions_eng): For operationalizing, suggest adding simple tags and a claim window record. Example mapping to push via our intake webhook:
```
crm_payload:
  account: OmniRetail
  origin: si_integratorx
  claim_window_days: 21
  evidence: ["demo_recording_url", "po_signed?:no"]
```
(tina: we can hardcode claim_window_days per partner tier)
opsbot (bot): Created ticket #PRT-4827: "IntegratorX claim window + announcement gating" and assigned to partnerships.
elaine (partnerships): Next steps: 1) @deepak — confirm demo/POC evidence by EOD. 2) @sam — open deal desk thread for split rules. 3) @tina — add CRM tag mapping to intake webhook. 4) partnerships to follow up on NDA for announcement gating.
sam (sales): On it — will open deal desk and cc legal.
deepak (solutions_eng): POC recorded and uploaded to GDrive: https://gdrive.re/redwood/integratorx-omni-poc
tina (field_engage): Added mappings to intake webhook and set claim_window_days=21 for IntegratorX (will monitor).
elaine (partnerships): Great. One more: if IntegratorX wants marketplace listing + joint announce, checklist -> NDA signed, co-branded assets approved, announcement date locked with PM. Tagging product-team next.
sam (sales): +1. Also recommend a short SLA: SI must respond to intro within 48h or they forfeit exclusive claim.
deepak (solutions_eng): Agree, add SLA to ticket.
opsbot (bot): Ticket #PRT-4827 updated: claim_window=21d, SLA=48h, attachments added.
elaine (partnerships): Nice. I'll draft a one-pager for IntegratorX outlining claim terms and joint announce checklist and drop it into the ticket. :thumbsup:
sam (sales): Nice — thanks.
(tina reacts :eyes:)
